english.title: Assault on officer of county court while in the execution of his / her duty
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(1) of the County Courts Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
assaulted an officer of the county court
while in the execution of his / duty

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A bailiff of the court may take the offender into custody, with or without warrant, and bring him before the judge.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE STATEMENT OF FACTS..).

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.
OR: On an order made by the judge in that behalf, to be committed for a specified period not exceeding 3 months to prison or to such a fine as aforesaid, or to be so committed and to such a fine, and a bailiff of the court may take the offender into custody, with or without warrant, and bring him before the judge.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
